name: Wewo
description: Werewolf on your phones. The host creates a room, friends join by scanning a QR code or typing a 4-letter code, and everyone secretly gets dealt a role. Play Campfire mode around a real table with the host narrating, or Online mode where the server runs every timed day and night phase.
highlights: 11 built-in roles (Werewolf, Seer, Witch, Hunter, Troublemaker, Jester and more), plus custom roles in Campfire mode
Online mode runs a server-side phase machine: timed day chat and public votes, then a night order of Seer → Werewolves → Witch → Doctor → Bodyguard → Troublemaker
Last words, a private werewolf den, a graveyard chat for the dead, a sky that shifts to a blood moon, and a post-game log of who did what
Game state lives in SQLite, so refreshed or disconnected phones get their seat back; if the host drops for 30 seconds, another player takes over
One Docker container: Bun serves the Next.js static export, the WebSocket and the database on a single port, deployed with Dokploy
